final_claim: Rank-maximal and egalitarian stable-match optimum sets coincide on every complete strict two-by-two market, while the complete three-by-three domain has exactly 42756 equality profiles, 2928 profiles with strict rank-maximal containment in the egalitarian set, and 972 disjoint profiles, with no reverse containment or nonnested overlap.
limitations: Finite exact classification only through three agents per side.
